action_instruction: Checking the matching My times entry details
intent: whether the My times list entry has project Mobile App, activity Development, description Sprint planning, and duration 2:00

action_params.condition: the "My times" list shows an entry for project "Mobile App" with activity "Development", description "Sprint planning" and a duration of 2:00
action_params.query: whether the My times list entry has project Mobile App, activity Development, description Sprint planning, and duration 2:00
action_params.code_js: (() => { const cells = el(56).querySelectorAll('td'); return cells[4]?.textContent.trim() === '2:00' && cells[9]?.textContent.trim() === 'Mobile App' && cells[10]?.textContent.trim() === 'Development' && cells[11]?.textContent.trim() === 'Sprint planning'; })()

assertion_tree.description: the "My times" list shows an entry for project "Mobile App" with activity "Development", description "Sprint planning" and a duration of 2:00

sub_results.description: the "My times" list shows an entry for project "Mobile App" with activity "Development", description "Sprint planning" and a duration of 2:00

assertion_tree.verification: An entry in the "My times" list has project "Mobile App", activity "Development", description "Sprint planning", and duration 2:00.
